title: {{NAME}} and the Fairy Dinosaur's Sky Rescue
moral: The bravest heroes listen to those who are small but wise.

pages.content: {{NAME}} soared over a prehistoric land. Tall volcanoes and giant ferns filled the ground below. Dinosaurs grazed in the valleys. A tiny fairy flew up next to {{NAME}}. 'Help!' said the fairy. 'A baby dinosaur is stuck on the high cliff and cannot get down.'

pages.content: {{NAME}} flew toward the cliff. The baby dinosaur looked down with huge scared eyes. Its little legs shook. 'Do not worry,' called {{NAME}}. 'I am coming!' The tiny fairy flew alongside. 'Fly slowly,' she said. 'The wind is strong near the cliff.'

pages.content: {{NAME}} slowed down, just as the fairy said. The wind was very strong. Step by step, {{NAME}} got closer. The baby dinosaur reached out a small claw. {{NAME}} grabbed it firmly. Then {{NAME}} lifted the baby dinosaur off the cliff and flew it safely to the ground.

pages.content: They landed on the soft ground. A huge mother dinosaur came running. She made a loud happy roar and nuzzled her baby. The baby dinosaur jumped and chirped with joy. The fairy flew a loop around {{NAME}}'s head. 'You listened,' said the fairy. 'That is what made you a true hero.'
